# Lumari
Lumari are a species of sophont insectoids similar to moth people, but with a much wider variety of bug-like appearances. Their features may resemble moths, beetles, bees, and other insects.
Lumari hail from the Starfall sector, where their ancestors shared a world with Aranei, Dionae, and Lithoids.
Like moth people, Lumari can gain nutrition from plant fibers that most other species find indigestible, and they prefer somewhat cooler environments.
Their insect blood cannot be replenished from iron in the same way as ordinary blood.
Their wings provide better acceleration in zero gravity, though they still require equipment to move when stranded in open space.
They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Cold damage[/color], but suffer [color=#ffa500]30% more Heat damage and catch fire more easily[/color].
